questions.q: What is the functional difference between a data owner and a data steward at LTV Global?
options: The owner is accountable at the business level and settles disputes or funds fixes; the steward does the daily hands-on work of monitoring and fixing data
They are two names for the exact same job
The steward outranks the owner in every decision
Owners work only in IT, while stewards work only in Finance
questions.explain: The lesson draws a clear line: owners are business-accountable decision-makers, stewards do the daily operational work and flag issues upward.

questions.q: Who is the data owner for Products.SKU, and who is the steward?
options: Owner: Tom Okafor (VP of Merchandising); Steward: Diego Marsh
Owner: Dana Whitfield; Steward: Renata Silva
Owner: Priya Anand; Steward: Grant Lindqvist
SKU has no assigned owner or steward
questions.explain: The assignment table names Tom Okafor as the Product domain owner and Diego Marsh as the steward for Products.SKU.

questions.q: In the Customers.Email RACI, who is Accountable for a routine data-quality conflict decision?
options: Renata Silva, the data owner
Dana Whitfield, the CDO, in every case
Priya Anand, the steward, in every case
No one is Accountable for routine decisions
questions.explain: For the normal data-quality decision, Renata Silva (owner) holds Accountable; the RACI shows that shifting to Dana Whitfield only for the regulatory-request activity.

questions.q: Why doesn't Dana Whitfield personally own any single critical data element?
options: As executive sponsor, she clears roadblocks and funds the program across all domains rather than owning one domain herself
She has no real authority in the program
CDOs are never involved in data governance programs
She owns all four elements simultaneously
questions.explain: The lesson describes her role as sponsor above all four owners — funding and championing the program, not personally accountable for one domain.

questions.q: What does a RACI table make explicit, according to this lesson?
options: Exactly who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed for a specific activity, rather than leaving it assumed
The server hosting location for each system
The exact dollar budget for the governance program
A list of every employee at LTV Global
questions.explain: The lesson frames the RACI as turning 'someone should probably handle this' into a specific, named answer for each activity.
